cim: OpenAI Chief Scientist Urges Industry Limits on AI Development
cim_eredeti: OpenAI Chief Scientist Urges Industry Limits on AI Development
szoveg_eredeti:
OpenAI’schief scientist proposed that artificial intelligence companies agree to limits on developing increasingly powerful models until researchers have better ways to understand and monitor their behavior.

Jakub Pachocki called for industrywide standards that would establish thresholds for AI development, with companies agreeing not to exceed them until specific safety requirements are met, according to a post published Sunday.

“I further propose common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing until our ability to understand and monitor AI behavior achieves a certain concrete milestone,” Pachocki wrote.
